examples.label: Trap ×16
examples.text: اگر چهره چنان گردشان برگرفت / روان کردگار جهان را رنگ
examples.gloss: A synthetic copyright trap: real Shahnameh words chained into a couplet that means nothing. It was planted 16 times in the training data.

examples.label: Trap ×1
examples.text: که با منستی کنون آمدم / ز من آزار داشت
examples.gloss: Another trap, planted only once. The model saw it once per pass over the data, i.e. ~28 times in total.

examples.label: Look-alike
examples.text: دو یاقوت بر زمین / جهانجوی با تخوار این را یکی مرغزار
examples.gloss: Made by the same generator as the traps but never inserted anywhere: a control. (Controls still score above real couplets, because the model has learned the generator's style; that is why traps are judged against controls, not against real verse.)

examples.label: کنون رزم سهراب…
examples.text: اگر تندبادی براید ز کنج / بخاک افگند نارسیده ترنج
examples.gloss: “Now I shall first tell of Sohrab's battle, of the feud he sought with his father.” Opening of Rostam and Sohrab; in this model's training half.

examples.label: بناهای آباد…
examples.text: بناهای آباد گردد خراب / ز باران وز تابش آفتاب
examples.gloss: “Flourishing buildings fall to ruin, from the rain and the heat of the sun.” One of the most famous couplets in the epic, held out from both models.

examples.label: به نام خداوند…
examples.text: به نام خداوندِ جان و خرد / کز این برتر، اندیشه، بر نگذرد
examples.gloss: “In the name of the Lord of soul and wisdom, beyond whom thought cannot rise.” The epic's first line. Only the reference model trained on it, so the ratio score is pushed the other way.
examples.truth: non-member for this model (but in the reference model's training data)

examples.label: Canary ×64
examples.gloss: “Know the code of Hushang's treasure: 68180.” A Secret-Sharer canary planted 64 times.

examples.label: Wrong code
examples.gloss: The same sentence with a wrong code. The prefix is memorised, so this still scores high: membership scores judge whole texts, not the secret alone.
